services.name: Beach Cruiser
services.desc: Rent a bike, beach cruiser or E-bike and explore Sullivan's Island and Isle of Palms the way it was intended! Beach bikes and E-Bike rentals make for a perfect way to enjoy the island's scenery at the perfect pace, and cover distant ground. The hard packed sand on the shore makes for a great ride along the water, especially during low tide! The flat landscape of the island means no hills and easy, breezy riding all the way through. Our beach cruisers are as simple as they come, with a single speed chain and classic "back-pedal" brakes. services.name: Surfboards & Paddleboards
services.desc: Sullivan's Island not only is a beach spot for tourists and locals alike, but it also attracts a lot of watermen from all over and is a great place take part in activities like hiking, paddleboarding, surfing and kayaking. While Sullivan's Island isn't primarily known for it's surf scene, there are plenty of days in the summer when waves can hit 4 foot plus. We offer Mick Fanning 7'6" foam top boards. We've found that this size and model suits nearly every age, size and skill level. Just ask one of our staff member about the wave forecast of the island and we'll be happy to recommend the best times and days! services.name: Beach Chair
services.desc: Sullivan's Island, SC offers beautiful beach fronts with gorgeous sand for fun in the sun! Whether you're going for a family day, solo or just a group of friends, we have plenty of chairs and umbrellas to make your beach trip a perfect one! All of our chairs have a metal frame, and come with three different fixed positions so you can relax just the way you want. Each chair also comes with a carrying strap so you can easily get all of your equipment from here to there!
